summary: check:utilities was wrong about gradients in both directions at once. `bg-linear-to-b` is a DIRECTION, and the bare bg- pattern resolved it against --color-linear-to-b and failed the build for writing a correct gradient; meanwhile there was no from-/via-/to- namespace at all, so every colour STOP in a gradient went unchecked and `via-nonsense-role` passed while emitting nothing. ImageOverlay is the first component to draw one — the first-of-its-kind rule landing on a utility FAMILY again. Both halves probed failing-first with a throwaway file before and after the fix.

migration.manual: Tooling only — no distributed item changed. A gradient stop naming a role the theme does not emit now fails the build instead of silently emitting nothing.
